title.en: Am Act Appropriating Funds for the Support of Pensionados in Insular

text.en:
The sum of thirty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury
not otherwise appropriated, for the support of the pensionados in the Insular schools, to be expended in
accordance with existing law.
Enacted. February 3, 1913.
